## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] macOS tests pass, or the change does not affect macOS
- [ ] iOS generic-device build passes, or the change does not affect iOS
- [ ] Relevant manual test matrix completed
- [ ] No signing files, personal identifiers, or build products added

## Safety

Explain any effect on app hiding, Screen Time shields, recovery, or unsaved work. Write `None` when the change cannot affect these areas.
